transformation.T: T of a molecule in one role of one array: mean product of the condition patterns (residual after an intercept and slope on the condition means, product-forming pairs) over its ordered pairs of pairs sharing a condition, divided by the array's mean pattern variance.
transformation.a: T over all owner contexts of the 38 molecules with at least two owner contexts and no non-owner context among arrays with a clear owner (DC1), and over all non-owner contexts of the 15 molecules with at least two non-owner contexts and no owner context.
transformation.b: The 29 molecules of the G1 and G1_all_only sets of DC1, all arrays: D = mean T as owner - mean T as non-owner. Interval: 10,000 resamples of the 29 molecules with default_rng(20261004) after the four earlier Phase 1 intervals (the exact resamples are in FigS3_all_context_draws.csv); 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the mean.
transformation.c: For each of the 23 molecules of Fig. 3B and each array of its contexts, every pair containing it is removed and both role shares refitted; margin = owner share - partner share after the refit (owner as in Fig. 2A).
transformation.d: Recombined share of a role = sum over its molecules of n x T / sum of n, n = ordered pairs of pairs; published = Fig. 2A.
